items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Johnson - drums. That was a beautiful session.

ctx.x: Reunion album and see what we can do to get together on it." So, he got all these fellows together. Yeah. That was '71, right?

He had Dud Bascomb, Ernie Royal, Bobby Johnson, Johnny Grimes-trumpet-yeah, that's the one; Dicky Harris, Matthew Crumley, trombone. They all played with me during the years. Crummley used to be with Jimmy Lunceford. Earl Warren also, used to be with Jimmy Lunceford. He was on the album. Ruben Phillips was the director at the Apollo. Ruben Phillips also went to 'Bama State at the time when Julian Dash was there. That's the year after I left. Bobby Green, alto and tenor sax, Haywood Henry - clarinet and soprano…

We started one evening. We had a little, we had like a little banquet (inaudible) cause we hadn't, a lot of us hadn't seen each other in quite a while. I know I hadn't seen quite a few of them in years. So, it was a big surprise to me.
